content:
If the equation of a plane P, passing through the intersection of the planes,
x + 4y - z + 7 = 0 and 3x + y + 5z = 8 is ax + by + 6z = 15 for some a, b $$ \in $$ R, then the distance of the point (3, 2, -1) from the plane P is...........
